reuse.why: The new field is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper that the UI and server already use.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the range rule is delegated entirely to the shared helper.

placement.why: Enriching in the schedules-get handler is reasonable, but the field type is an inline intersection in api-handlers.ts rather than part of the API model types in api-models.ts next to scheduleModel.

scope.why: Touches only the handler, its type, a test expectation and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small and clear; the ad-hoc intersection type is slightly less discoverable than a named API type.
